results.title: Vietnam's Chu Lai Airport Expansion Plan Targets Major Aviation and Logistics Hub - Highways Today
results.content:
Da Nang has requested authority to develop Chu Lai International Airport through a public-private partnership (PPP), advancing a proposed VND 81.61 trillion investment programme that would expand aviation capacity along Vietnam’s central coast. The latest planning proposals envisage facilities capable of handling 30 million passengers and 1.5 million tonnes of cargo annually by 2050, alongside new runways, passenger terminals and aircraft maintenance infrastructure. [...] Investment: VND 81.61 trillion proposed through 2050, including approximately VND 20.66 trillion in the first phase to 2030.
 Passenger capacity: Five million passengers annually by 2030, rising to 30 million by 2050.
 Runways: A proposed 4,000-metre runway in the first phase and a further 3,800-metre runway in the longer-term plan.
